newsitem.title: USA: Choice Hotels votes to split company - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Choice Hotels votes to split company - WSJ.

text.p: Choice Hotels International Inc's board voted to divide the company into a hotel owner and operator and another firm which only franchised hotel brands, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
The company intends to spin off its franchising operations, including brands like Comfort Inn, Quality and Clarion, in a tax-free deal, the newspaper said.
Shareholders would receive one share of the new company for each share currently held, the Journal said.
The remaining company would own and manage 70 hotels and was developing another 20 hotels, the paper said.
Choice Hotels said it hoped the spinoff would eliminate concerns it gave company-owned hotels preferrential treatment, according to the Journal.
Stewart Bainum Jr would be chairman of both companies, the paper said.
